mira: Quick sync 1: small model-catalog update needed for the "export-ready" section on model cards. Customers exporting embeddings to external DBs get schema/type errors (float32 vs float64) + mismatch on dims. Can someone own a tiny PR with sample export snippets and a migration note?

jess: I can take it. Plan: compatibility table (dtype+dim per variant), short py/js snippets to cast & normalize embeddings before export, and a reindex checklist for Pinecone/Qdrant. ETA today.

omar: Add a micro-bench note about serialization size when switching to float32 vs float16 and the expected retrieval score delta (~0.01).

kyle: Also include a short SDK v5 snippet showing `client.embeddings(..., dtype="float32")` and a fallback that raises a clear error if dim mismatch.

jess: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1208 1 includes snippets, table, and reindex steps. I added a tiny example CSV (5 rows) that users can run locally.

docbot: CI started for PR #1208  docs-lint + linkcheck + preview build queued.

docbot: CI passed for PR #1208. Preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1208/export-ready-compat.html

mira: Quick scan on preview looks good. Two tiny asks: 1) add a one-line "when not to export" (sensitive PII vectors) and 2) link model-card quant profile page.

jess: Added both and pushed. Also collapsed the long table into a compact version for mobile.

omar: LGTM. The reindex checklist includes exact Pinecone CLI commands and Qdrant reimports. Nice and copy/pasteable.

kyle: Approved, merging after docbot confirms preview link stable.

docbot: PR merged -> main, publish: /model-catalog/export-ready-compat.html, ts 3543211029

mira: Thanks all 44f please ping support & product for the release note.
